id.description: Stable unique slug, used as the folder key for downloads/icons and the SD card install folder.

filename.description: Filename of the downloaded artifact. Extension must match fileType (.nro for "nro", .nsp for "nsp", .xci for "xci", .zip for "port").

fileType.description: "nro": homebrew app, installed directly into sdmc:/switch/<id>/ and launched from hbmenu. "nsp"/"xci": installable title, installed natively via NCM/ES/NS with a manual DBI (https://github.com/rashevskyv/dbi) fallback. "port": a homebrew app that isn't a single .nro - downloadUrl points to a .zip containing the .nro plus whatever data files/subfolders it needs (e.g. a native port's asset pack), extracted into sdmc:/switch/<id>/ preserving its folder structure.

parentId.description: If set, this entry is DLC/an update for the base game with this id - hidden from the main list/grid, shown instead in that game's detail screen. The target should itself have no parentId (one level of nesting only).

contentType.description: Only meaningful when parentId is set - label shown for this entry in its parent's DLC/updates list.
